description: Pins protocol::parse_account_number byte mapping for cross-implementation conformance: 20-character Crockford-base32 canonical + Damm-32 check digit + display formatter + liberal-parsing normalization (case, hyphens, MY- prefix, whitespace). Damm-32 polynomial form per design notes.md 2026-04-28 freeze. Twelve cases: 6 parse_ok permutations all normalize to the same AccountNumber, 6 parse_fail covering length / non-Crockford-char / Damm-32 substitution + transposition. Cases generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_account_number_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored`.

cases.description: Pure canonical 20-char Crockford-base32 form (19 entropy + Damm-32 check). The baseline shape every other parse_ok case normalizes to.

Canonical 27-char display form: 'MY-' prefix + four 4-char Crockford groups + '-' separators + final 4-char group containing 3 entropy + 1 Damm-32 check. Liberal-parse strips prefix + hyphens to recover canonical.
Canonical form with all chars lowercased. Spec §5 normalizes case-insensitively before alphabet validation; output canonical is always uppercase per §3.
Display form with all chars (incl. 'MY-' prefix) lowercased. Same case-insensitive normalization applies; prefix strip happens after lowercase.
Display form without the 'MY-' prefix (only the four 4-char groups + final 4-char group, hyphen-separated). Spec §5 makes the prefix optional in liberal parse.
Display form with leading + trailing ASCII spaces. Spec §5 strips surrounding + interior whitespace before alphabet validation.
18-char input — one char short of canonical 20. Spec §5 step 6 length-check rejects after normalization.
21-char input — one char over canonical 20. Same length-check rejects.

Contains 'O' — Crockford base32 alphabet excludes O (visually conflated with '0'). Spec §5 step 7 rejects STRICTLY — no I/L → 1, O → 0, or U → V lookalike substitution. The Rust parser uses the alphabet exactly as documented.
cases.informational_failure_reason: contains non-Crockford character 'O' at index 0 — strict reject per spec §5 step 7

cases.description: Contains 'I' — Crockford base32 alphabet excludes I (visually conflated with '1'). Same strict-reject policy as 'O'.
cases.informational_failure_reason: contains non-Crockford character 'I' at index 1 — strict reject per spec §5 step 7

cases.description: Single entropy character flipped vs the baseline canonical (entropy[7] '7' → '8'); Damm-32 check digit unchanged. Damm-32 by design catches all single-character substitutions; this case proves the implementation honors that property per design notes.md 2026-04-28 polynomial freeze.
cases.informational_failure_reason: Damm-32 substitution catch: entropy[7] '7' → '8', check digit 'T' unchanged

cases.description: Adjacent entropy characters swapped vs the baseline canonical (entropy[2] '2' ↔ entropy[3] '3'); Damm-32 check digit unchanged. Damm-32 by design catches all adjacent-pair transpositions; this case proves it.
cases.informational_failure_reason: Damm-32 transposition catch: entropy[2,3] '2','3' → '3','2', check digit 'T' unchanged
